title: IMCOT saturates to -+i for im > 354.5 or im < -354 before checking |re| >= 2^27 and returns "0" for real |re| >= 2^27
statement: In Excel 16.0 builds 20430 and 20527, IMCOT(inumber) checks im > 354.5 (returning "-i") and im < -354.0 (returning "i") before checking |re| < 2^27. On the real axis (im = 0), |re| >= 2^27 returns "0" (whereas IMTAN returns #NUM!), tan(re) = 0 returns #NUM!, and otherwise it returns RN53(RN64(1/tan(re))). Off-axis, it uses Excel's circular reduction and flushes subnormal real quotients to 0; 1,283/1,283 pinned and 1,228/1,243 full-bank rows match (15 off-axis rows differ by up to 55 ULP on build 20527.20196).
basis: Measured in Excel 16.0.20527.20088 (jnt_parity_complex rows 402-412, 604) and CalcFunc-Evidence cache/w111-extended-regenerated-20260929/answers-imcot.json.gz (Excel 16.0 build 20430); 1,283/1,283 pinned and 1,228/1,243 full-bank rows match.
